style_block: Desaturated documentary-realist photography, muted period-accurate color palette, naturalistic window and overhead lighting, slight film grain, candid unposed framing as if shot on 35mm consumer film in the 1990s, generic unbranded packaging and signage rendered as plain shapes rather than real logos, no modern devices or fixtures visible anywhere. Strictly no readable text, words, letters, numbers, or lettering of any kind anywhere in the frame - no signs, no labels, no posters, nothing legible.
reference_notes: Desaturated documentary realism, chosen to read as an actual period photograph without literally being one. Matched to the Ultimate Nostalgia reference channel's POV-immersion format (their own videos aren't tied to one specific visual treatment, so this leans toward authenticity over the VHS-camcorder look used on the Blockbuster Friday Night project). Original art only - no real brands, logos, or trademarked characters/shows.
